response.sql: WITH by_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, AVG(s.aream2 / NULLIF(s.volm3, 0)) AS area_to_volume_figure FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_figure) AS cross_source_average FROM by_source) SELECT b.fundflux, b.avg_y_vs_x_difference, b.area_to_volume_figure, b.area_to_volume_figure - m.cross_source_average AS above_average FROM by_source AS b CROSS JOIN benchmark AS m WHERE b.area_to_volume_figure > m.cross_source_average

assumptions.assumption: A missing funding source is excluded; a zero denominator makes that record’s corresponding ratio undefined and excludes it from that average.
